body:
Review triage for performance comment 5830656003:

- The add-funds and open/close-position timeouts in run 36118599225 were reported on historical commit 99ea0b2. These flows do not execute the remove-margin validation changed here, so they are outside this PR resolution and remain undiagnosed.
- Current removal validation at 8178666ec8b64f9ec090db0e6ced7331d088b105 passed changed-file lint/format checks, 245 unit tests, 7 component view tests, and the iOS Hyperliquid testnet recipe, 104/104 steps. This evidence covers the margin-removal behavior and does not claim to resolve those Android performance timeouts.
